mathematical_definition: nan_to_num(vol_state_tercile, nan=0) * 3 + nan_to_num(persistence_state, nan=0) -- a single combined regime id in [0, 8] encoding the 3x3 cross of the vol_state_tercile and persistence_state tercile buckets (arithmetic combination of two of the other family-I discretized variables above; not a fitted HMM state)
numerical_stability_notes: NaN in either input component is zero-filled via np.nan_to_num before the arithmetic combination, so composite_state_id itself is never NaN -- it silently collapses a NaN vol_state_tercile or persistence_state to bucket 0 rather than propagating missingness; downstream consumers cannot distinguish 'genuinely low tercile' from 'input was NaN during warmup'
missing_value_policy: Never NaN (nan_to_num floors both inputs to 0 before combining); effectively 0 during either input's warmup window rather than a true missing-value signal
